integers.description: Uniform integers in [min, max] via rejection sampling.

backend_name.description: IBM backend to target; omit to auto-select the least busy device. Ignored when mode='emu'.
backend_name.title: Backend Name

bell_witness.description: Add 8 qubits carrying four CHSH Bell pairs measured in the same job (fidelity witness).
bell_witness.title: Bell Witness

derive.description: Optional unbiased integers/floats derived from the conditioned bytes.

epsilon_log2.description: Extractor security parameter: output is 2^-epsilon_log2-close to uniform.
epsilon_log2.title: Epsilon Log2

include_raw_counts.description: Echo the raw counts so third parties can recompute the output.
include_raw_counts.title: Include Raw Counts

mode.description: 'emu' samples on a local Aer simulator (classical baseline, uncertified); 'qpu' samples IBM hardware.
mode.title: Mode

num_qubits.description: Width of the randomness register (Born-rule bits per shot).
num_qubits.title: Num Qubits

output_bytes.description: Conditioned bytes requested. You receive min(output_bytes, extractable).
output_bytes.title: Output Bytes

prev_pulse_hash.description: Previous beacon pulse hash to chain onto (hex).
prev_pulse_hash.title: Prev Pulse Hash

public_seed.description: Toeplitz seed: a shipped seed id (default 'toeplitz-v1', uniform seed from a documented ceremony — information-theoretic mode) or any custom string (SHAKE-256 expanded — computational mode, labelled as such).
public_seed.title: Public Seed

qpu_instance.description: IBM Quantum instance CRN; BYOK override, omit to use mothbackend's own shared IBM credentials.
qpu_instance.title: Qpu Instance

qpu_token.description: IBM Quantum API token; BYOK override, omit to use mothbackend's own shared IBM credentials.
qpu_token.title: Qpu Token

require_assumption_free.description: Certify only on the assumption-free tier (whole-shot most-common-value bound, no independence assumed). Capped near log2(shots) bits per shot; ≈0 in counts mode, so this effectively needs per-shot memory readout.
require_assumption_free.title: Require Assumption Free

shots.description: Number of measurement shots (max 10,000). Raw bits = num_qubits × shots.
shots.title: Shots

errorCodes.description: Parameter validation failed (e.g. circuit exceeds the EMU cap of 20 qubits).
The circuit needs more qubits than the selected IBM backend provides.
IBM authentication failed — no usable token/instance (shared or BYOK).
Could not retrieve the QPU result — job cancelled, failed, or backend errored.
The QPU job did not reach a terminal state within the engine's 6000 s poll deadline; the provider job was cancelled.
The backend returned counts that do not match the submitted circuit.
